capability: Replace with the exact live HPC capability under proof.

hardware.memory_topology: Replace with NUMA node, memory size, and locality topology.
hardware.accelerator_model: Replace with GPU/accelerator model or state none when not relevant.
hardware.driver: Replace with driver/runtime version or state none when not relevant.

system.operating_system: Replace with OS image, kernel, and architecture.

toolchain.compiler: Replace with C/C++/CUDA compiler versions when relevant.
toolchain.mpi_implementation: Replace with MPI implementation and version or none when not relevant.
toolchain.scheduler: Replace with Slurm/Kubernetes/provider scheduler version or none when not relevant.

runtime.command: Replace with the exact command line used to generate evidence.

environment.RUSTFLAGS: Replace with effective value or none.
environment.LD_LIBRARY_PATH: Replace with effective value or none.

runtime.input_scenario: Replace with scenario, seed manifest, FMU, checkpoint, or benchmark input.

storage.filesystem_or_object_store: Replace with local, Lustre, GPFS, object store, or provider storage details.

review.reviewer: Replace with reviewer name or handle.

waiver.expires: Replace with waiver expiry or none for real live-hpc manifests.
